title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the object-owner verdicts out of protocol.ts into protocol-object-owner.ts (#25467 cut 17)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 17 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–16 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104 and #26168. The claim is `6421301816`; the scope is the cut 17 proposal of the cut 16 report (`6418840219`), as the server seat approved it in its dispatch order. Both members passed the AST screen and moved unedited, so no member was left behind. `ensureObjectStorage` stays where it is, per the order.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-owner.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the object-owner verdicts:

- `classifyObjectContribution`: which contributor kind (`own`, `overlay` or `mismatch`) a stored object row registers as, judged against the registry's packaged owner of that name, or its runtime owner when there is none.
- `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner`: hands an adopted object's name from the `'sys_metadata'` sentinel owner to its rebound row.

`protocol.ts` loses 37 net lines (29,327 to 29,290). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread, restarted from `main` `df8aac41f2` after cut 16 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `4d5121bee` and three merges of `main`: `f2e7083695` (`1c5dda251`), then `81bba6c3f5` (`2c409efd84`) and `3d50a43bcb` (`5e5bf4438e`), the last two because `dispatch-gates` printed STALE TREE for gate sources that `main` had changed. No merge touches a file of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`: the package's `src/` tree is `575f85d7` at the move commit and at every merge. The merges do change `packages/metadata-protocol/package.json` (`sideEffects: false` and the repository URL) and its `tsconfig.json` (now extends `tsconfig.base.json`), so the workspace was rebuilt in full after them and the package re-measured (below).

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** Measured just before this PR was opened: of the 36 open PRs, two touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/`.

- #26244 edits `protocol.ts` (+5 / −2): the import block at `:163` and a hunk at `:23178`. Neither is in a moved member or its stub, and `git merge-tree` of this branch with #26244's head is clean.
- #26138 edits seven `protocol.*.test.ts` files, none of which names a moved member.

No open PR edits the new module.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor` in either body.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has a `new Error(` or any other error constructor, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed. `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` has one `catch`, which logs through `console.error` and answers `false`; it moves with its body (see the durability `--list` below).

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `classifyObjectContribution` | `:17512` | private | 29 | 221 |
| `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` | `:26125` | private | 22 | 185 |

51 body lines (the proposal said about 55).

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–16 apply it)

- **The class keeps every member** with its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 17]`.
- **Typing.** `ObjectOwnerHost` types its one member as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['engine']`). Each moved function types its `this` as `Pick<ObjectOwnerHost, 'engine'>`, and each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType` of `typeof fn`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk** (property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped; bare `this` checked too): both bodies read `engine` only (through `(this.engine as any)?.registry`). It is handed over as a live getter, so the body reads the protocol's engine, and so its registry, at call time.
- **Every other caller still calls the class method**: `classifyObjectContribution` from `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `saveMetaItem`, `promoteDraftForPublish` and `loadMetaFromDb` (4 `this.` call sites), and `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` from `reassignOrphanedMetadata` (1).

## Module-level declarations

- **None moves and none gains `export`.** Neither body reads a module-level declaration of `protocol.ts`, and neither reads an import. The new module imports only the class type (`import type` from `./protocol.js`), so it adds no runtime edge to the `protocol.ts` cycle.
- **Imports in `protocol.ts`.** No import loses its last reader. The one new statement is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list`

`releaseAdoptedObjectOwner`'s `catch` moved file, so the list was read at both ends. `check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output, and its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (159 lines; no entry changes file, and no entry names either moved member at either end). The `catch` guards `registry.unregisterObject`, a registry call, and the list names no entry for it at either end.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`, sorted-union identity, measured first. Base `df8aac41f2` and head `4d5121bee` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (119/119). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap; `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` clean, and both touched blobs equal to `HEAD`'s after. Measured on the pre-merge tree, and again after each merge of `main` (heads `1c5dda251`, `2c409efd84` and `5e5bf4438e`, the last two after a full `pnpm build`, 119/119). The readings below hold for every one.

- **Raw sha256**: `08914e65f936a2b031c3f3f215481a97f53d132eefd869e4f42d928947ebe173` at base and at head, on both `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`, 775,874 bytes each. **Raw identity holds**, so sorted-union identity holds too. Both members stay `private NAME;` lines.
- **Normalised sha256**: `46ccd7e5c4db673652513d1801ec9c9f06bf34a0a7fb6ba97fb2531ef0cc544b` at both ends (80 string-literal union runs sorted; the cut 12 normaliser).
- **The two builds differ where they should**: `index.js` hashes `bfb1ef96fc8499bc…` at base and `8732ec7d7e0d5cd5…` at head. The `.call(host` sites of `classifyObjectContribution` and `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` occur 0 times in the base bundles and once each in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike).
- **Positive control** on the head tree: `private` was dropped from `classifyObjectContribution` (on disk, restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `c685a8419f36b078…` (normalised `524c41057de3c18c…`) and print `classifyObjectContribution(name: string, rowPackageId: string | null | undefined): { kind: 'own' | 'overlay'; …`, so the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head; the sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all four. Neither moved function nor `ObjectOwnerHost` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token** (the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, JSDoc skipped, over parameters less the added `this`, return type and body), base `protocol.ts` at `df8aac41f2` against the head module:

```
classifyObjectContribution: base tokens 221, head tokens 221, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
releaseAdoptedObjectOwner: base tokens 185, head tokens 185, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=406 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=300 head=300 order-same=true byte-identical=298 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=245 head=246 byte-identical=245
```

**Negative control**, one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module (`binding !== ownerPackageId` to `binding === ownerPackageId`, one occurrence):

```
MUTATED packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-owner.ts "binding !== ownerPackageId" -> "binding === ownerPackageId"
classifyObjectContribution: base tokens 221, head tokens 221, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
releaseAdoptedObjectOwner: base tokens 185, head tokens 185, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=406 differ=1 members=2
```

- **Class side.** 300 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 298 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Each of the 2 stubs sits at its base position and keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical (everything before the body's opening brace).
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 245 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +125 / −51 over 2 files, 176 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 200–260). `protocol-object-owner.ts` has 111 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

Every test and script that reads `protocol.ts` by path was grepped for the two member names. So was every test file in `packages/` and `ui/`, and `docs/qa/`.

- **By path: none reads a moved body.** `protocol.object-registry-write-through-spelling.test.ts` names `releaseAdoptedObjectOwner` only in a comment (line 67); neither moved body holds a spelling it counts, and it passes at both ends (in the package suite).
- **Behaviour through the class method, no edit owed.** Three `packages/objectql` tests name `classifyObjectContribution` in their headers and drive it through the save and hydration doors: `protocol-runtime-owner-overlay-refusal.test.ts`, `protocol-sentinel-owner-draft-save-address.test.ts` and `protocol-sentinel-owner-package-save-refusal.test.ts`. Run at head after the full build: 3 files, 27 tests passed.
- No hit in `docs/qa/`.
- **ADR anchors and decision letters.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 with identical output at both ends. Neither body cites an ADR; their `[#23416]` and `[#23514]` comments are issue citations, which move with them.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13974 → 13976, 13999 → 14001; the two-line import comes before them). `productionFiles` is 3,733 at base and 3,735 at head: +1 is the new file, +1 is the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` the spec build writes in the head tree.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `df8aac41f2`.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h`: 0 of 2 paths hit the register, NOT governed; 176 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 before and after the merges. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` (the whole touched package; it has no `lint` script, these are the root `lint` script's flags) exits 0, no output.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status (vitest `--maxWorkers=2`, JSON reporter, each run under the shared verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` both legs), on the pre-merge tree (no merge changed a file of the package's `src/`):
  - Base `df8aac41f2`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - Head `4d5121bee`: 21,558 tests (21,539 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 269 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `df8aac41f2` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 1 anchored file in the change set, 29 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `5e5bf4438e`, with no stale-tree warning; all 53 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (119/119). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. (The same 53 also all exited 0 on the first merged tree `1c5dda251`, before the STALE TREE re-merges.)

## Carry-forward

Unchanged from cut 16. These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `packagelessAddress`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, and `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
- `ensureObjectStorage`, the object-owner family's other member, stays per the order (its pin would need widening).
